design: Cross L6 query raw pre-MLP baseline and finite input response from paired contexts; RMS normalize each endpoint, run exact MLP, transplant only resulting module response onto recipient module baseline. Four cells own/input_swap/baseline_swap/both. Surrounding recipient and incoming skip response unchanged.
prediction: Response follows transplanted local state if local geometry explains conditioning, or surrounding context if later readers/other token states matter; interaction between them is possible.
limitations: Hybrid local-state substitutions are diagnostic, not guaranteed on-manifold. State swap changes the entire local residual, not a semantic gate. Other token states/native context unchanged.
dose_test: Prespecified positive coefficients .025,.05,.1 on H807 bird panel. Primary bars format only; newlines exploratory due item gate. Compare with saved H810 IOI .25/.5 and H807 copying .25/.5; no layer/head reselect or per-example dose matching. Inspect displacement and response curves, not causal shares.
